decisions.statement: Which properties are held in a file is read from the page properties rather than from a list here.
The index files the path a page states whether or not a file stands there.
A file is present when the change answers with a body for its path.
A file is absent when the change answers with nothing.
The body standing at a path the change does not name is answered by the base commit.
A file the declaration claiming that file states uncommitted is passed over.
Which declaration claims a file is read from the page's own type rather than from the property.
A page named for a page type the change itself has is judged.
A file property the change introduces is asked for its file.
A page having a changed path is judged even when the change never names that page.
Which page has a changed path is composed out of that path's own name.
A page type the change itself writes names pages here as a landed one does.
A page the change takes away is passed over.

definition: the check refusing a page that states a property held in a file it does not have
